answer: Bonded identities lock collateral in escrow, so splitting one operator into k coordinated identities does not dilute accountability: correlated equivocation triggers aggregate penalties proportional to k², reflecting pairwise evidence links. On detection, an exponential multiplier increases capital loss across the swarm, while asymmetric depreciation prevents recycled stake from regaining full value. Whether the swarm glows as ember, mirror, or whisper, conflicting signed messages expose its coordination and make sybil control economically costly.
